note: City of Missouri Valley's campground along the north and west sides of City Park and the Harrison County Fairgrounds; a busy railroad runs along the south edge of the grounds. --Claude
summary: Added the rate from the city's page ($25 electric, $15 tent); confirmed first-come with no reservations, seasonal, dump station. Cleared hookups (50 A, water), site count/pull-through and the 14-night limit, which only directory-based note prose gave. Fit: RV Life campers in fifth wheels and travel trailers. Pin at the park's Huron St entrance, ~10 m from Google's listing; left.
flags: SEASON: the city says only 'Camping is available seasonally'; no opening or closing dates on any city page, so the note's 'Open ~Apr 15-Oct 15' was dropped and season stays year_round false only.

FIT: no posted length limit; RV Life campers stayed in fifth wheels and travel trailers (9/2025 'This park is well kept and easy to maneuver'; 4/2026 'This is parking in the fairgrounds parking lot. There is electric at all sites'). A 23-ft motorhome fits.

PIN: stored 41.55728,-95.90596 is at the park's north entrance on Huron St, ~10 m from Google's 'Missouri Valley City Park Campground' (913 W Huron St). The city puts the camping 'along the north and west sides of the park and fairgrounds'; the pads are not distinguishable on NAIP, so not changed.
PHONE: stored 712-642-3502 is City Hall (city page and Google); the page also lists park maintenance, Kenneth Randeris, mobile 402-510-8677. Left.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (park and fairgrounds in town, no water nearer than a drainage ditch east of the park).
Note: removed the site count, hookup, booking, season and stay-limit text (now in fields or unsupported by the city).
